svg.text: Every color softened to 65% of its chroma, then tinted 10% toward plasma's dusk, a purplish burgundy, so the set reads
as one evening. Lightness never moves.
Each ring is a Default color, each dot the palette's; the arrows are the moves between, in order:
HUE AND COLORFULNESS: angle is hue, distance out is chroma
⊕ dusk: what every color is tinted toward
Default's lightness at each key; grounds take plasma's dusk (dark) or sunrise (light) hue, inks the other end.
Each key's lightness against Default's ramp: ring Default, dot this palette (its fill is the key's own color, so a tint shows).
PLASMA, WHERE THE PALETTE SAMPLES IT
0.4 dusk: the dark ground and the slots' tint
